verdict.rationale: Splitting a sale is a fair question for a point-of-sale product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers carts, discounts, Tap to Pay, voiding payments and tips, but none of it documents splitting one sale across multiple payment methods or payers. Accepting several card and wallet types (Tap to Pay) is a different capability from splitting a single sale.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can split a single sale across multiple payment methods or payers
